title: FLA import: CPicButton trackAsMenu skipped; button sounds (up/over/down states) not decoded
description:
readCPicButton() in flash8-binary.ts now reads the trackAsMenu byte (instead of skipping it) and forwards it through the full pipeline.

Changes made:
1. Fla8Instance interface (flash8-binary.ts): added trackAsMenu?: boolean
2. readCPicButton() (flash8-binary.ts): reads r.u8() and stores as trackAsMenu; conditionally includes in return object
3. convertElement() (flash8-import.ts): forwards el.trackAsMenu to SymbolInstance
4. SymbolInstance (engine/types.ts): added trackAsMenu?: boolean field (committed in fix 0890)
5. Symbol model (model/types.ts): added trackAsMenu?: boolean field (committed in QA run 4)
6. encodeDefineButton2() (buttons.ts): uses symbol.trackAsMenu with optional trackAsMenuOverride (committed in QA run 4)
7. compileDocument() (compile.ts): passes displayObj.trackAsMenu as trackAsMenuOverride (committed in QA run 4)

Tests: 301/301 pass (pnpm --filter @flash/core run test -- --run)
